meta.dataset: Website ownership research on 10,000 businesses from the all-business directory
meta.method: The 10,000 best-fitting businesses with a matched website (by size, distance to a BSP hub, industry code and record quality; fit_score and segment_rank) had their own websites read. Each site was fetched and up to 50 pages kept (median 20 for sites that answered); sentences about ownership, founding, family, sale and staff size were pulled out, and a model gave a probability for each ownership call. Confidence is the probability of the call; it is left empty where the re-check changed the call, since the probabilities belong to the first call.
models: Claude Haiku 5.5 read the pages each site served (up to 50) and made the ownership call, with the quote it rests on.
Claude Sonnet 5.5 re-checked 1,080 calls, trying to refute each, and changed 187; of the 1,041 final founder-run and family-owned calls, 900 were re-checked.

fields.confidence: probability of the call (0 to 1); empty where the re-check changed the call
fields.founder_family_p: probability it is founder-run or family-owned (empty where the re-check changed the call)
fields.cue: the sentence on the site the call rests on (contact details, review text and people's names removed)
fields.reader_note: the reader's own note about the site when it gave no quote (a redirect, an error page, a known roll-up)
fields.changed_by_recheck: the first call, where the re-check changed it
fields.fit_score: target fit score 0 to 100 (size, distance, industry code, record)
fields.segment_rank: rank by fit within the segment

websites.source: Overture Maps Foundation, Places theme release 2026-10-21.0 (CDLA-Permissive-2.0; some rows also Apache-2.0 or CC0-1.0). Sources include Meta, Microsoft, Foursquare and OpenStreetMap contributors as listed per row.
websites.match_method: Normalised legal name and DBA (lower-case, &->and, punctuation and legal suffixes removed) matched to Overture place names within the same ZIP or 3 miles of the business ZIP centroid (2024 Census ZCTA gazetteer). Accepted: exact name key (a place filed under an unrelated top-level category such as food and drink also needs the domain to spell the name); the same distinctive words with the domain spelling the name or two-plus words and 6+ distinctive letters; a subset or near-identical spelling only with the domain spelling the name. Social, directory and site-builder hosts are not counted as websites; domains carried by 4+ places (chains) are penalised; a domain claimed by several businesses keeps the best.

meta.deals_format: deals: {business id: {status, buyer, date, evidence_url}}; status sold_or_pe_backed, still_independent, unclear (no sale found, but no dated source confirms the current owner) or no_deal_found. Filled by a search of public news for a sale or investment.

deals_search.method: Public news and web search (one or two searches per business) for a sale, merger or outside investment.
